preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call callget() function
Victim address must have some BOND token balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function to transfer tokens from any victim address to your own address. This function bypasses normal ERC20 transfer restrictions and approval checks, allowing you to steal tokens directly from any holder. The vulnerability is that callget() uses _transfer() directly without checking allowances or sender permissions.
